itemUsage.en: Caster Operator Lappland has just closed the curtains on a grand performance.
itemUsage.zh: 术师干员拉普兰德，刚刚结束一场盛大的演出。

itemDesc.en: Be it in the city or out in the wilds, once the show begins, she will not abide any half-hearted performances.
itemDesc.zh: 无所谓城市或者荒野，演出开始时，她不允许还有人没能全情投入。

description.en:
Passive Effect: Drone <@ba.vup>+1</>
<@ba.rem>Active Effect: Can switch between the default state and the following state:</>
ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, releases Drones to lock and attack non-mobile enemies across the entire battlefield, searching for a new target if the enemy moves or is defeated
description.zh: 被动效果：浮游单元<@ba.vup>+1</>\n<@ba.rem>主动触发可以在下列状态和初始状态间切换：</>\n攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，释放浮游单元随机锁定整个战场内的非移动敌人进行攻击，目标移动或倒下后重新索敌

description.en:
Drone <@ba.vup>+{attack@cnt}</>, Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, releases Drones to lock and attack random enemies; when Drones attack, they have a <@ba.vup>{attack@prob:0%}</> chance to inflict <$ba.fear>Fear</> for <@ba.vup>{attack@fear}</>s
<@ba.rem>When the Drone's locked-on target is defeated, they will search for a new one; when the skill ends, they return to the Operator</>
description.zh: 浮游单元<@ba.vup>+{attack@cnt}</>，攻击范围<@ba.vup>扩大</>，攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，释放浮游单元随机锁定敌人攻击，浮游单元攻击时有<@ba.vup>{attack@prob:0%}</>几率使目标<$ba.fear>恐惧</><@ba.vup>{attack@fear}</>秒\n<@ba.rem>浮游单元在锁定目标倒下后重新索敌，直至技能结束后返回干员身边</>

description.en: Drone <@ba.vup>+{attack@cnt}</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, releases <@ba.vup>special</> Drones that scatter across the entire battlefield and chase the closest enemy to them; upon reaching their target, inflicts <$ba.fear>Fear</> for <@ba.vup>{attack@fear}</>s, locks the target and attacks it; enemies around the Drones have <@ba.vup>{attack@move_speed:0%}</> Movement Speed and take <@ba.vup>{attack@magic_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage every second (does not stack); <@ba.rem>When the Drone's locked-on target is defeated, they will search for a new one; when the skill ends, they return to the Operator</>
description.zh: 浮游单元<@ba.vup>+{attack@cnt}</>，攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，释放<@ba.vup>特殊形态</>的浮游单元散开后在整个战场范围各自追逐较近的敌人，追上时使目标<$ba.fear>恐惧</><@ba.vup>{attack@fear}</>秒并锁定其攻击，浮游单元周围的敌人移动速度<@ba.vup>{attack@move_speed:0%}</>且每秒受到相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@magic_atk_scale:0%}</>的法术伤害（不叠加）；<@ba.rem>浮游单元在锁定目标倒下后重新索敌，直至技能结束后返回干员身边</>

Operator Lappland the Decadenza has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for manipulating hovering units to combat and pursue the enemy in concert.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Caster Operator during field operations to exercise Mech-accord Caster responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.

干员荒芜拉普兰德擅长操纵浮游单元协同作战，追击敌人
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为术师干员，行使驭械术师职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en: It's almost eight. She's out by the forest, and now she's getting impatient. Whatever happens, she needs to be home before nine. A rule her father made. She's allowed to die, but not to break this rule. So, she has made herself a rule too: before eight, finish everything she has to finish, and kill everyone she has to kill. But she hasn't finished her job today. The enemy's had more forces hidden than the Saluzzos expected, and things are getting bogged down. Her guys have the ride home ready. She knows her father doesn't give a shit about her results, just that she's punctual. So she chooses to get on. But the enemy choose this moment to loose a pack of trained tuskbeasts, a handful of which breach the vicinity, and charge straight aboard the wheels, aimed straight for her throat. They can't get near her, of course; she dodges easily, and decapitates them in the same motion. Still, something tells her they slashed something on her. She looks down. It was the pocket watch. They scratched the glass face and left a real deep claw mark. She can't tell the time through it. A hint of nerves immediately bolts through her. But right after that, a surprising sense of relief. The tension she felt a moment ago vanishes into thin air. 'Lemme out,' she suddenly says. Her goons push back as hard as they can, but she gets out anyway, and paces one step at a time towards the forest. Tick tock, tick tock, it's eight o'clock. She paces into its depths, vanishing without a trace. Today, it'll take her until the dead of night before she's killed them all, and only at the crack of dawn will she finally traipse back through the Saluzzos' door. Today, Alberto will fly off his goddamn handle. Today, Lappland will smile a big happy smile. ...... 'There's a story that goes like... A girl gets a spell cast on her that turns her beautiful, but then she'll turn back right at the stroke of midnight.' Idly fiddling with her watch, she throws out a sudden remark. 'Zaaro, you scared the magic'll run out? Scared you'll just die like a nameless tuskbeast out in the barrens where nobody'll ever know?' 'What a fool's question. You disrespect the Signore dei Lupi's very nature.' 'You know, most humans—the ones you see as toys—they think the same way. And in my eyes, you're all the same. 'You think the spell cast on you will last forever and forever, and then there comes a day, a moment the magic wears off, and you howl like a mutt how it wasn't meant to be this way.' 'What? And you think you're an exception?' 'No, Zaaro. I think that's when you get to see the real me.' She places the watch to her ear, shuts her eyes, and oh-so-softly taps at its shell in time with the faint second hand. 'Tick-tock, tick-tock, it's eight o'clock.'
description.zh:
快八点了。站在树林边，她感到十分焦躁。
无论发生了什么，她必须在九点前回家。这是父亲定下的规矩。她可以停止呼吸，但不能违背这条规矩。于是，她也为自己定下了规矩——八点前，把该做的事做完，把该杀的人杀光。
但今天，事情还没有结束。敌人隐藏的势力超出了萨卢佐的预料，事态陷入了泥沼。
手下们为她准备好了回去的车，她知道，父亲不在乎她的成果，要的只是她的守时。
她选择了上车，然而，敌人在这时放出了驯养的牙兽们，有几只突破了包围，窜入车中并瞄准了她的喉咙。
它们当然伤不了她，她轻松闪过，并反手将它们斩杀。但是，她能感觉到，它们的爪子还是划到了自己身上的什么东西。
她低头看去，是怀表。牙兽的爪子划过表镜，留下了深深的爪痕。
她看不清时间了。
她立刻感到了一丝慌张，但是，随之而来的，却是安心。刚才的焦躁感在这一瞬间消失了。
“让我去。”她忽然说。
手下们极力反对，但她依然走下车，一步一步向着树林走去。
嘀嗒，嘀嗒，八点了。
她走入树林深处，不见踪影。
这一天，她直到半夜才杀光了敌人，黎明时刻，她才慢悠悠地踏入了萨卢佐的家门。
这一天，阿尔贝托大发雷霆。
这一天，拉普兰德笑得很开心。
……
“有这样一个故事。一个女孩被施了变美的魔法，但是过了十二点，她就会变回原样。”她把玩着手中的怀表，忽然说道，“扎罗，你害怕魔法消失吗？害怕像一头无名的牙兽一样默默无闻地死在荒野上吗？”
“无聊的问题，你在侮辱狼之主的存在。”
“你知道吗，在你眼中只是玩具的大部分人类，也像你这么想。而在我眼里，你们都一样。
“理所当然地认为施加在自己身上的魔法永远不会消失，到了魔法失效的那一刻，则哀嚎着这一切不该是这样。”
“你呢，你难道能够置身事外？”
“不，扎罗，直到那时候，你才能真正见到我。”
她将怀表放在耳边，闭上眼，随着秒针的转动用指尖轻轻敲打着表壳。
“嘀嗒，嘀嗒，八点了。”
